criteria.name: Best-of-8: attention KL <= 0.5x int quantization on all 6 caches (exp 01's C5)
criteria.source: Experiment 01 C5 threshold; worst over caches and repeats

criteria.name: Best-of-8 mean KL <= 0.7x a single random rotation's mean KL
criteria.source: Needs a material gain, not noise; mean over caches and repeats

criteria.name: Selection costs <= 1 s per cache on one CPU core
criteria.source: Must be cheap enough to run once per layer at model load

negative_control.name: Worst-of-8 (same signal, inverted) also meets C1's 0.5x on all caches
negative_control.source: If picking the worst candidate still passes, the selection signal carries no information
